name: boat
description: A centre-console motorboat: a deep-V planing hull with chines and a raised sheer, floating on the waterline (y = 0), a navy topside stripe and rub rail, a teak cockpit sole and a non-skid casting deck, a console with windscreen and wheel, helm, aft and bow seats, a bow rail, and an outboard engine that steers about its transom mount.
